_comment: Machine-readable source of truth for the SEO/AEO routine. The routine reads this each run; the monthly deep-dive edits it (promotes unmatched queries, retires dead ones, re-ranks priority). gsc_patterns are lowercase JS-regex strings used by scripts/seo/pull-gsc.mjs to bucket Search Console query rows into clusters. Messaging must always follow seo/strategy.md: positive framing, 'active transportation' not 'sustainable', never positioned against cars.

clusters.audience: People shopping for a car (especially a used car) who could be won over to an e-bike on cost and practicality.
queries: cost of commuting by car vs bike
cheapest way to commute to Boston
how much does commuting cost per month
proposed_assets: A used cargo e-bike price page — see the 2026-09-08 deep-dive: variants of '"tern gsd" used "$3000"' took 34 impressions over the 28 days to 2026-09-04 at position ~10, recurring across two pulls, with no page of ours answering what a used cargo e-bike costs around here.
aeo_questions: How much money can you save commuting by e-bike instead of a car?
Is an e-bike cheaper than a used car?
clusters.messaging_notes: Lead with what the e-bike GIVES — money kept, time reclaimed, no parking hunt, daily fresh air. Present numbers honestly (the commute advisor already frames 'X min vs Y min driving'). Never disparage cars or car owners; this is an additive comparison, not a takedown.

clusters.audience: People who just moved (or are about to move) to the Greater Boston area and are rethinking how they'll get around.
queries: moving to Boston how to get around
do I need a car in Boston
getting around Boston without a car
Boston public transit guide for newcomers
aeo_questions: Do you need a car to live in Boston?
What's the best way to get around Boston without a car?
clusters.messaging_notes: Frame as a warm welcome and a practical head start, not a lecture. Show the options that already work well here (T, bus, Bluebikes, walkable neighborhoods). /nearby is the killer asset — it answers 'what's near my new address' instantly.

clusters.audience: Parents wondering whether they can realistically carry kids and cargo by bike.
queries: how do families bike to school
proposed_assets: Verify/expand existing cargo-bike + carrying guides; consider a 'family by bike' hub
aeo_questions: Can you carry kids and groceries by bike?
What's the best cargo bike for a family?
clusters.messaging_notes: Show families that this is joyful and doable — 'here's how families around here actually do it.' Concrete gear, real setups, school-run logistics. Never imply anyone should give up their car; add a capability, don't subtract one.

clusters.audience: Greater-Boston residents worried they can't walk/bike/ride transit year-round because of weather.
queries: biking to work in the rain
is it safe to bike in snow
proposed_assets: Confirm existing weather guides rank; consider a seasonal 'year-round riding' hub refreshed each fall
aeo_questions: Can you bike through a Boston winter?
What gear do you need to bike commute in the cold?
clusters.messaging_notes: Normalize and equip: 'plenty of Bostonians ride all winter — here's the gear and the know-how.' No toughness-shaming, no 'excuses' framing. Practical, encouraging, specific to New England conditions.

clusters.audience: Greater-Boston college students working out how to get around their campus and the city — T pass subsidies, campus bike shops and repair co-ops, Bluebikes student discounts, shuttles and late-night rides. Discovered in the 2026-09-08 deep-dive: the twelve /shift-your-semester pages took 917 impressions in the week to 2026-09-04 (36% of all site impressions) and every one of those queries bucketed as noise.
queries: college student semester T pass Boston
gsc_patterns: \b(bu|mit|tufts|harvard|northeastern|neu|suffolk|simmons|berklee|lesley|emerson|umass|bc|boston college|boston university)\b.*(bike|bikes|bicycle|blue ?bike|bluebike|t.?pass|tpass|mbta|charlie|shuttle|safe ?ride|red ?eye|parking|transit|commut|cycle kitchen|bike kitchen|car rental|rental car|zipcar)
proposed_assets: The twelve /shift-your-semester/<school> pages already exist and rank on page one for these queries; the 2026-09-08 title rewrite (commit e0635fb) is the live experiment. Next lever if titles are not enough: give each page a FAQPage block answering the pass/discount/shuttle questions verbatim.
aeo_questions: How do college students in Boston get a discounted MBTA pass?
Where can a student get their bike fixed on campus in Boston?
clusters.messaging_notes: These pages must earn the click by answering the campus question first — the pass subsidy, the bike co-op, the shuttle — and only then invite students into Shift. Cite the source for every campus perk so the facts stay checkable. Students arrive without a car in the picture at all, so there is nothing to compare against: lead with what is already free or subsidized for them. This cluster sits ahead of town-commuters in this file on purpose — bucketing takes the first matching cluster, and 'boston university bike' would otherwise fall to the town patterns.

clusters.audience: People looking up a specific named local route — the Fresh Pond loop, the Emerald Necklace, the Minuteman, the Community Path — usually to find out how long it is, where it starts, and what it is like to walk or ride. Discovered in the 2026-09-14 pulse: twelve /shift/roams pages took 852 impressions and 12 of the site's 21 clicks (57%) in the week to 2026-09-11, and the named-route queries behind them were all filed as unmatched noise.
queries: how long is the fresh pond loop
gsc_patterns: (fresh pond|emerald necklace|minuteman|community path|charles river|charles loop|freedom (stroll|walk|trail)|marblehead|silvio conte|fort river|mass central rail trail|mcrt|watertown branch|wwii veterans memorial|battle road|shining sea|manhan|twin cities rail trail|wachusett greenway|mystic river greenway|alewife|north point|bakery run|sunset pedal|b-?line crawl|museum hop|harbor walk|eastie eats|salem by rail|harbor islands|city of squares)
proposed_assets: The twelve /shift/roams/<id> pages already exist and rank around position 8 for these queries. First lever: put the distance in the title, since the query is usually a request for that number (see the 2026-09-14 report, item 2).
aeo_questions: How long is the Fresh Pond loop?
Where does the Minuteman Bikeway start and end?
clusters.messaging_notes: These searchers already intend to walk or ride — there is nothing to persuade. Answer the factual question first (distance, surface, where it starts, how to get there without driving) and let the route itself do the inviting. Like students-campus, this cluster sits ahead of town-commuters on purpose: bucketing takes the first matching cluster, and 'community path somerville' or 'minuteman' would otherwise fall to the town patterns and be read as town-page demand. Note when comparing to earlier runs that town-commuters figures before 2026-09-14 include some of this traffic. Pattern maintenance (2026-09-21): the original name list was drawn from the twelve Roams that happened to be indexed on 2026-09-11, so as the rest indexed their queries fell straight back into unmatched — battle road trail (25 impressions), shining sea bikeway (4) and salem/b-line/bakery-run traffic were all unbucketed in the week to 2026-09-18, and cluster coverage fell 88% -> 73%. The alternation is now generated from all 25 published Roams. Regenerate it whenever a Roam is added; a cluster fitted to the indexed sample rather than the published inventory decays every time the class grows.

clusters.audience: People looking for something specific to turn up to — a learn-to-ride class, a free bike repair workshop, a group ride, a community fair — usually in a named town and usually soon. Discovered in the 2026-09-21 pulse, once the page table stopped truncating at 40 rows: 33 event URLs took 299 impressions and 7 clicks at 2.34% CTR, the best-converting class on the site, and every query behind them was filed as unmatched noise.
proposed_assets: The event pages already exist and already rank at positions 3.6-7.7. First lever is discovery, not content: 33 of them earn impressions while the sitemap lists two and llms.txt lists none (see the 2026-09-21 report, item 2).
aeo_questions: Where can I get my bike fixed for free in Boston?
Is there a learn-to-ride class in Cambridge this month?
clusters.messaging_notes: These searchers have already decided to come to something; answer the practical question first — what it is, when, where, whether it costs anything, whether you need to register — and let the event do the inviting. Placed AFTER students-campus and roams-trails because bucketing takes the first match and a campus bike-kitchen event belongs with the campus pages it shares a searcher with; placed BEFORE town-commuters so 'learn to bike cambridge' does not read as town-page demand.

clusters.audience: Boston-area residents searching for how to walk/bike/ride transit in their specific town — the core organic asset.
queries: bike to work for beginners Boston
proposed_assets: Extend town pages as new towns pass the publication gate; consider neighborhood-level pages for the biggest towns
aeo_questions: How do people bike commute in Somerville?
How does Bluebikes work?
clusters.messaging_notes: Town pages already lead with the question people search (per recent Search Console-driven rewrites). Keep titles answer-shaped; keep live local stats front and center.

clusters.audience: People who think about trips in drive-minutes and want to know what those minutes are on foot or by bike. Discovered in the 2026-08-24 pulse: /commute-advisor and /guides/when-walking-is-faster were the site's two largest impression sources and neither had a cluster.
queries: how far is a 10 minute drive walking
what is a 5 minute drive in walking
how long does a 2 mile walk take
aeo_questions: How far is a 10-minute drive on foot?
How long does a 5-minute drive take to walk?
clusters.messaging_notes: Answer the number first, plainly, before offering the tool — the query is a request for a figure. Lead with what walking and biking give: the trip is usually shorter than people assume and there is no parking to find at the end. Present driving honestly as a legitimate option; this is a conversion table, not a comparison that scores points.

clusters.audience: People already curious about e-bikes, researching before buying — feeds the used-car cluster.
queries: how far can an e-bike go on a charge
e-bike vs regular bike for commuting
where to try an e-bike near me
proposed_assets: Guide on the MA e-bike incentive landscape; surface e-bike demo events from the events calendar
aeo_questions: Is there an e-bike rebate in Massachusetts?
How far can an e-bike go on one charge?
clusters.messaging_notes: The Massachusetts e-bike incentive angle is a high-intent magnet. Keep facts current (freshness-check territory). Route demo-seekers to real local events.

clusters.audience: HR and sustainability leaders looking for commute programs, RTO support, and workplace challenges.
aeo_questions: How do you run an employee commuter challenge?
What are commuter benefits for employees?
clusters.messaging_notes: Searchers may type 'sustainability' — target the query, but our copy says 'active transportation.' Lead with what teams get: participation, aggregate impact reporting, easy setup, privacy-safe.

clusters.audience: Teachers, PTAs, and district staff looking for school wellness and safe-routes programming.
queries: walking school bus how to start
gsc_patterns: (safe routes|walking school bus|walk to school|bike to school)
proposed_assets: How-to content for teachers/PTAs starting a program
aeo_questions: How do you start a walking school bus?
What is a good active school wellness program?
clusters.messaging_notes: Lead on simplicity and the no-student-data design. Free for MA schools. Health, focus, and community independence framing (matches the schools page).

clusters.audience: Local business owners who could join the Rewards Partner network — low volume, highest commercial intent.
queries: small business marketing Cambridge foot traffic
proposed_assets: Rewards Partners page rewrite (current page is client-rendered, thin on ranking content) — first structural experiment candidate
aeo_questions: How can a local business reach people who walk and bike nearby?
clusters.messaging_notes: Free to join, no fees, no contracts, no POS integration. Frame as reaching engaged local neighbors. This is the weakest-vs-intent page; prioritize its rewrite.

clusters.audience: People already looking for us, the Shift app, or one of our programs and events by name. Not an acquisition target — bucketed so the ledger can tell branded demand apart from demand we have yet to capture.
clusters.messaging_notes: Measured, not optimized. Watch the ratio of branded to non-branded impressions over time: growth that is only branded means awareness work is landing but the discovery content is not. Program brands (Green Line Velo, Recreation Sundays, Frisoli) sit here too because the searcher already knows the name.

clusters.audience: Cross-cutting question-shaped queries used to measure answer-engine presence. Not a landing-page target on its own — each maps to a page above.
queries: how much money do you save biking to work
what is the cheapest way to get around Boston
can you commute by bike with kids
how do people bike in winter in Boston
do you need a car in Boston
aeo_questions: How much money do you save biking to work?
What is the cheapest way to get around Boston?
Can you commute by bike with kids?
How do people bike in winter in Boston?
clusters.messaging_notes: These six are the fixed AEO sentinels the routine spot-checks every run for citation presence. Keep them stable so the citation-count trend is comparable over time. gsc_patterns is empty on purpose — this cluster is measured by live search/AEO checks, not GSC bucketing.
